feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 23 November 2026 4:00am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds soon developing.


##Wind)##

South or southeast 4 or 5, backing southeast 5 or 6 in the afternoon and occasionally 7 later.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate, building moderate or rough later.


##Weather)##

Fair at first, then patchy rain later in the evening.


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 9°C and max. air temperature 10°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds. Gales for a time.


##Wind)##

Southeast 5 to 7, soon increasing 6 to gale 8, decreasing 6 or 7 later.


##State of sea)##

Moderate or rough, becoming mainly moderate later.


##Weather)##

Patchy rain becoming widespread and persistent for much of the day and sometimes heavy.


##Visibility)##

Good, becoming moderate or poor in rain area.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 8°C and max. air temperature 10°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
##Wednesday, 25 November 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds until later.


##Wind)##

Southeast 6 or 7, soon decreasing 5 or 6, backing east or southeast 3 to 5 later.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight later.


##Weather)##

Outbreaks of rain, becoming mainly fair later.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate in rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 7°C and max. air temperature 8°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
##Thursday, 26 November 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds soon developing.


##Wind)##

East or southeast 3 or 4, soon veering southeast 5 or 6, increasing 5 to 7 later.


##State of sea)##

Slight, becoming mainly moderate later.


##Weather)##

Fair at first, risk of rain later.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate in any rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 6°C and max. air temperature 7°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
##Friday, 27 November 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds.


##Wind)##

Southeast 5 to 7.


##State of sea)##

Moderate occasionally rough.


##Weather)##

Occasional rain, possibly heavy at times.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain.

Min. air temperature 7°C and max. air temperature 8°C
